statement.ru: У осьминога больше нейронов в щупальцах, чем в голове.
statement.en: An octopus has more neurons in its arms than in its head.

why: Two-thirds of an octopus's neurons are in the nerve cords of its arms.

statement.ru: Тюлень-крабоед питается в основном крабами.
statement.en: The crabeater seal lives mainly on crabs.

why: Despite the name it eats no crabs; over 90% of its diet is Antarctic krill.

statement.ru: Медуза живёт без мозга.
statement.en: A jellyfish lives without a brain.

why: Jellyfish lack a true brain; they have a ring-shaped nerve net instead.

statement.ru: Медузы появились на Земле позже динозавров.
statement.en: Jellyfish appeared on Earth after the dinosaurs.

why: Jellyfish have existed for at least 500 million years; dinosaurs appeared about 230 million years ago.

statement.ru: Кораллы — это животные.
statement.en: Corals are animals.

why: Corals are colonial marine invertebrates (animals, phylum Cnidaria), not plants or rocks.

statement.ru: Большой Барьерный риф видно из космоса.
statement.en: The Great Barrier Reef can be seen from space.

why: Wikipedia: the reef can be seen from outer space; it is the biggest structure built by living things.

statement.ru: Омары кричат, когда их бросают в кипяток.
statement.en: Lobsters scream when they are dropped into boiling water.

why: Lobsters have no lungs or vocal cords; the whistling is air and steam escaping the shell.

statement.ru: Дельфины зовут друг друга по «именам» — особым свистам.
statement.en: Dolphins call each other by 'names': their own special whistles.

why: Bottlenose dolphins have unique signature whistles that others use to address them, like names.

statement.ru: Осьминог может прожить полвека.
statement.en: An octopus can live for half a century.

why: Octopuses live short lives, up to about four years; most die soon after breeding.

statement.ru: Бивень нарвала — это зуб.
statement.en: A narwhal's tusk is a tooth.

why: The narwhal's tusk is an elongated canine tooth growing from the upper jaw.

statement.ru: Белухи рождаются белоснежными.
statement.en: Beluga whales are born snow white.

why: Beluga calves are born grey and turn white only slowly as they age.

statement.ru: Некоторые кальмары умеют вылетать из воды и пролетать десятки метров.
statement.en: Some squid can leap out of the water and fly for tens of metres.

why: Flying squid of the family Ommastrephidae can glide through the air for up to 50 m.

statement.ru: Нарвал — выдуманное животное, как единорог.
statement.en: The narwhal is a made-up animal, like the unicorn.

why: The narwhal is a real Arctic whale; its tusk was once sold as unicorn horn.

statement.ru: Японский краб-паук в размахе ног бывает шире трёх метров.
statement.en: A Japanese spider crab's legs can span more than three metres.

why: Its leg span reaches about 3.75 m, the largest of any arthropod.

statement.ru: Детёныш кита обычно появляется на свет головой вперёд.
statement.en: A baby whale is usually born head first.

why: In whales and dolphins the calf is usually positioned for a tail-first birth.

statement.ru: Рак-богомол может ударом разбить стекло аквариума.
statement.en: A mantis shrimp can break aquarium glass with a punch.

why: Mantis shrimp have been recorded breaking glass tanks with their club strike.

statement.ru: Самое глубокое место океана — около трёх километров.
statement.en: The deepest point of the ocean is about three kilometres down.

why: The Challenger Deep is about 10.9 km deep, more than three times that.

statement.ru: На кончике каждого луча морской звезды есть глаз.
statement.en: A starfish has an eye at the tip of each arm.

why: Starfish have an eyespot of 80-200 simple ocelli at the end of each arm.

statement.ru: Касатки живут только в тёплых морях.
statement.en: Orcas live only in warm seas.

why: Orcas are found in all oceans from the Arctic to the Antarctic, most often in cool waters.

statement.ru: Морские черепахи «плачут» — так из них выходит лишняя соль.
statement.en: Sea turtles 'cry' to get rid of extra salt.

why: Their tear glands shed tears saltier than seawater, removing salt from the body.

statement.ru: Моржи живут и в Арктике, и в Антарктиде.
statement.en: Walruses live in both the Arctic and the Antarctic.

why: Walruses live only around the North Pole, in the Arctic and subarctic seas.

statement.ru: На дне Марианской впадины побывало больше людей, чем ходило по Луне.
statement.en: More people have been to the bottom of the Mariana Trench than have walked on the Moon.

why: 27 people had descended to the Challenger Deep by July 2022; 12 people have walked on the Moon.

statement.ru: Морская черепаха может спрятать голову в панцирь.
statement.en: A sea turtle can pull its head into its shell.

why: Unlike many turtles, sea turtles cannot retract their head or flippers into the shell.

statement.ru: Гренландский кит может прожить больше 200 лет.
statement.en: A bowhead whale can live for more than 200 years.

why: Bowheads are the longest-living mammals, living for over 200 years.

statement.ru: Белуха умеет поворачивать голову и кивать.
statement.en: A beluga whale can turn its head and nod.

why: Unlike most whales, belugas have unfused neck vertebrae, so they can nod and turn the head.

statement.ru: Синий кит питается в основном рыбой.
statement.en: The blue whale lives mainly on fish.

why: The blue whale's diet consists almost exclusively of krill, tiny crustaceans.

statement.ru: Калан носит с собой камень в кармане под лапой.
statement.en: A sea otter carries a stone in a pocket under its foreleg.

why: Sea otters keep food and sometimes a rock for cracking shells in a skin pouch under the foreleg.

statement.ru: Петь умеют только самки горбатых китов.
statement.en: Only female humpback whales sing.

why: It is the male humpbacks that sing, mostly in the mating season.

statement.ru: Раки-отшельники выстраиваются в очередь по размеру, чтобы обменяться раковинами.
statement.en: Hermit crabs line up by size to swap shells.

why: Up to 20 crabs line up from largest to smallest and swap shells in turn (a vacancy chain).

statement.ru: Мидии держатся за камни корнями.
statement.en: Mussels hold on to rocks with roots.

why: Mussels are animals; they attach to rocks with byssus threads made by their foot.

statement.ru: У краба есть зубы — прямо в желудке.
statement.en: A crab has teeth, right in its stomach.

why: Crabs have a gastric mill: a set of teeth in the stomach that grinds food.

statement.ru: Тюлени рожают детёнышей прямо в воде.
statement.en: Seals give birth right in the water.

why: Seals and their kin come ashore or onto ice to give birth.

statement.ru: Из китового уса делали корсеты.
statement.en: Corsets used to be made with whalebone (baleen).

why: Baleen was used for corset stays, busks and crinoline petticoats.

statement.ru: Калана от холода спасает толстый слой жира.
statement.en: A thick layer of blubber keeps the sea otter warm.

why: The sea otter has no blubber; it keeps warm with its exceptionally thick fur.

statement.ru: Амбра, которую ценят парфюмеры, рождается в кишечнике кашалота.
statement.en: Ambergris, prized by perfume makers, forms in a sperm whale's gut.

why: Ambergris is produced in the digestive system of sperm whales and used as a perfume fixative.

statement.ru: Каракатица в родстве ближе к медузе, чем к улитке.
statement.en: A cuttlefish is more closely related to a jellyfish than to a snail.

why: Cuttlefish are molluscs, like snails; jellyfish are cnidarians, a different phylum.

statement.ru: Морской огурец дышит через задний проход.
statement.en: A sea cucumber breathes through its bottom.

why: Sea cucumbers draw water in through the anus to respiratory trees in the cloaca.

statement.ru: Криль — это мелкая рыбка.
statement.en: Krill are tiny fish.

why: Krill are crustaceans with an exoskeleton, like shrimp, not fish.

statement.ru: Устрица может за жизнь сменить пол.
statement.en: An oyster can change sex during its life.

why: Oysters are protandric: they spawn as males first, then as females.

statement.ru: Мечехвост — это разновидность краба.
statement.en: A horseshoe crab is a kind of crab.

why: Horseshoe crabs are not crabs or even crustaceans; they are closer to spiders and scorpions.

statement.ru: В Амазонке живут розовые дельфины.
statement.en: Pink dolphins live in the Amazon.

why: The Amazon river dolphin turns pink as an adult, hence 'pink river dolphin'.

statement.ru: Пищевод кальмара проходит сквозь его мозг.
statement.en: A squid's gullet passes through its brain.

why: The squid brain is a nerve ring encircling the oesophagus, so food passes through it.
